sources.entry: Headphones | Automated music downloader for NZB and Torrent

summary.one_liner: Headphones is a Python-based automated music downloader that fetches albums through NZB and torrent clients.
summary.what_it_does: Headphones is an automated music downloader for NZB and Torrent, written in Python. According to the README, it integrates with SABnzbd, NZBget, Transmission, µTorrent, Deluge and Blackhole. The README also mentions an artist overview homepage, settings pages, importing favorite artists, artist pages with bio and album overview, and album pages with track overview. The README links to installation, usage and troubleshooting pages in the wiki, and it describes IRC support and GitHub issue and feature request rules. The README does not give detailed run instructions in its body.
use_cases: fetch music through usenet NZB downloads
import favorite artists to track new releases
manage a music library with download clients
how_to_run: See the installation page in the project wiki (linked in the README)
notable: Supports multiple NZB and torrent clients: SABnzbd, NZBget, Transmission, µTorrent, Deluge and Blackhole
Imports favorite artists to drive automated downloads
Web-style interface with artist bios and album/track overviews (per README screenshots)
caveats: The README does not describe installation steps; it points to the wiki
Support is offered via IRC on Freenode, a server the README names as irc.freenode.net
